layout: summary + run-log + journal-common (report header and the start, bind and finish frames) + one case file per benchmark case + one journal-<case>-<experiment> file per experiment (its paired read frames, in plan order)
note: Pinned terminfo.dev@4.0.0 cases extensions.osc7-cwd and extensions.osc8, graded by a layered collector extension: extensions.osc7-cwd carries no fixture bytes and is inconclusive by design (preserved); extensions.osc8's termless code is executed over the journaled stored cells and hyperlink runs and decides, beside its inconclusive terminal path. Separately identified effect contracts grade paired complete stored cells, raw pane metadata (title, host working directory, hyperlink runs with snapshot-local identities) and session status by an independent oracle. Reported metadata and stored cells in a disposable direct-local App only.

context.ownedSavedPolicy: paired owned active-screen facts and source-known restoration witnesses; no direct inactive-bank inspection
context.ownedResizePolicy: parent-selected App resize in proved private pane; independent kernel geometry and -opost; original grid restored before stock
